skill-registry.description: Quản lý skill như plugin: cài/gỡ/bật/tắt skill từ GitHub, tháo lắp wise. Use when user wants to install skill from GitHub, manage skills, enable/disable skill, tháo lắp skill, sync skills, hoặc nói skill registry/plugin.

harness-workflow.description: Enforce Claude Harness v2 product-driven pipeline for all coding tasks

product-quality.description: Product quality standard for web UI/UX — beautiful, responsive, accessible

skill-usage.description: Wise skill usage — only load skill when description matches task

designer.description: Design product UI/UX: design system, wireframe, component states. Use when need beautiful interface, responsive layout, before coding.

explore.description: Explore codebase read-only. Use when need to understand project structure, find files, trace patterns before planning or coding.

implement.description: Implement code changes todo-driven. Use when executing plan todos, writing code, editing files, running checks.

plan.description: Plan architecture and task breakdown. Use when need to design implementation plan, break down requirements, create todos before coding.

polish.description: Polish UI/UX to product quality: responsive, states, animation, a11y. Use after implement, before verify, when UI needs beautifying.

verify.description: Verify build, tests, lint and fix loops. Use when need to validate implementation, run checks, auto-fix failures before done.

yunie.description: YUNIE — chatbot hệ thống Harness v2: hiểu toàn bộ hệ thống, thực thi task về hệ thống, kiểm tra tình trạng, cập nhật trang STATUS www/ và deploy GitHub Pages. Use when user says yunie, chatbot, status, kiểm tra hệ thống, cập nhật status page, www, github pages.

harness.description: Chạy full Claude Harness v2 pipeline Idea -> Explore -> Clarify -> PRD -> Design -> Plan -> Implement -> Polish -> Verify. Model-agnostic, product-driven.

implement.description: Implement plan đã duyệt theo todo-driven workflow. Đọc plan, chạy từng todo, verify sau mỗi edit.

plan.description: Tạo plan chi tiết Explore -> Plan cho task, xuất file .agent/plans/ và todos. Dùng trước khi implement.

polish.description: Polish giao diện đến chuẩn product: responsive, states, animation, a11y. Chạy sau implement, trước verify.

product.description: Biến 1 ý tưởng nhỏ thành sản phẩm hoàn chỉnh: PRD mini -> Design -> Plan -> Implement -> Polish. Dùng khi có ý tưởng mơ hồ cần thành product đẹp.

verify.description: Verify build/test/lint và tự fix loop đến khi pass. Chạy sau implement, trước khi done.
